cases.name: Julia Michelle Holland
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Julia was a volunteer for TIP (Trauma Intervention Program), Brother Wolf, Mountain Pet Rescue, and Scentsy Consultant. She loved crafts, painting, and loved spending time with her grandchildren. Julia worked as a CNA and also a Uber driver. She loved being a caregiver to everyone and was very protective. She enjoyed going to local shows. Julia loved her Bassett hound Winnifred. She was a woman with a big heart and a bigger smile. Julia would do anything for anyone. We will remember her not only for her kindness and compassion, but also for her strength and commitment to her family and friends."

She was an Uber driver.

Her adopted sister told (said) “Worked at nursing homes, she was a really good person," Kristen Bautista said. "She would help anybody. She would literally give her shirt off her back for anybody."
cases.narrative: On 1/3/2023, her body was found in his home, lying on the living room floor of the garage apartment in a pool of blood, during the execution of a search warrant by the Haywood County Sheriff’s Office. She had been shot once in the back of the head. “A probable motive for the murder of Ms. Holland by Mr. Bolden may have been sexual assault, either pre- or post-mortem,” Lt. Matthew Shell wrote in the request for a DNA test. “Due to the condition of Ms. Holland’s body and how her clothing was removed and/or cut away from her breasts and genital area, a sexual assault kit was collected upon the body of Ms. Holland at the time of the autopsy,” said Lt. Shell. The warrant describes the vile and horrific scene officers found shortly before 2 a.m. on Jan. 2. “Julia was lying supine upon the living room floor beside a love seat with a red stain consistent with blood upon the armrest of that love seat. Julia’s shirt was pulled up around her neck and her breasts were exposed,” Lt. Shell wrote in the affidavit seeking a DNA test of Bolden. Officers also noted body mutilation. “There was bruising on her stomach and what appeared to be some type of laceration around her left nipple,” Lt. Shell wrote.
